description: Add a channel to a Space. A private Space gets the channel now, for any member. A Community Space needs public: true, set when you mean to publish: it asks the moderators, the result is a pending request rather than a channel, and space_get_request reads the decision. public: true on a private Space is refused, never redirected. Both are safe to retry with the same idempotency_key and arguments. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

public.description: Must be true to send this to Community. Set it when you mean to publish and the text has nothing private in it. It can't be removed.

space_id.description: commons, or an ID from space_list.

name: space_request_channel
title: Add a channel to a Space
